array_shape_mode_note: Public Pythonic result declarations and first-dimension ARRAY_LEN follow ../array-result-shapes.md; older result-form and multidimensional-length rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
array_mode_note: Public Pythonic ARRAY value/result composition follows ../pythonic-arrays.md; older assignment-only and whole-value rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
evaluation_mode_note: Public Pythonic mode uses the chosen order in ../evaluation-order.md; older ordering rejections below are retained only for the future strict milestone.
numeric_mode_note: Public translation is Pythonic. Exact REAL restrictions below preserve the legacy contract for a future strict milestone; see ../numeric-modes.md.
boundary: Manual rules support named types, field access and reference binding. Tests establish the offline prototype only. Copy guards and storage preservation are explicit implementation policies, not authenticated controller observations.

rules.implemented: TYPE name = STRUCTURE with scalar fields (including BYTE/SHORT), fixed 1D/2D/3D scalar or prior named-structure arrays, and previously defined named structures. Different names remain different types even with identical layouts. Built-in XYZWPR, CONFIG and VECTOR data records can also be fields; see data_record_semantics.json.
rules.restriction: No other type aliases, inline structures, recursive or forward type references, external type definitions or routine-local types.

rules.implemented: Case-insensitive nested dot/index paths, including arrays of structures and arrays within their fields; existing INTEGER, REAL, BOOLEAN and STRING checks.
rules.restriction: USING supports bare named structure variables with lexical right-most field resolution, as recorded in using_semantics.json. Nested/complex selectors and namespace/counter collisions remain blocked. Supported XYZWPR/CONFIG/VECTOR fields are described in data_record_semantics.json. Other geometry fields, structure comparisons and aggregate UNINIT remain blocked.

rules.implemented: Bare structures, indexed structure elements, nested structure fields, scalar fields and indexed array fields bind to caller storage. Scalar fields use existing value/reference and numeric promotion rules; STRING and ARRAY fields retain caller capacity. Fresh local structure/structure-array frames and cleanup are supported.
rules.restriction: Bare references retain existing behavior. Named STRUCTURE values/results use the initialized bounded recursive copies recorded in structure_routine_semantics.json. Native layout, stack cost and controller alias behavior remain unverified.

rules.implemented: Independent field copies between the same named type, including nested structures and supported array fields. Destination aggregate storage is preserved recursively so captured structure-element, nested field and array references remain attached.
rules.restriction: Every source scalar leaf must be initialized and BYTE contents must be known before copying. The guard rejects partial/unknown copies before destination mutation. This restriction is a conservative policy, not a claim that KAREL prohibits all partially initialized structure copies.

rules.implemented: UNINIT accepts supported scalar variables, scalar fields and indexed scalar elements. Whole STRUCTURE and unsubscripted ARRAY arguments are rejected, matching the manual's explicit exclusions.
rules.restriction: No aggregate initialization predicate is introduced; PATH and other controller types remain unsupported.

rules.feature: Field effects and indexed assignment order
rules.implemented: Assignments to fields mark their root global/formal variable as potentially written. Fresh local structure writes remain local. Effectful function results assigned to indexed targets are rejected.
rules.restriction: Conservative analysis; no claim about KAREL target/value evaluation order. The indexed-result guard also applies to plain arrays.

unresolved: Partially initialized or unknown-BYTE whole structure-array copies
Native structure value-temporary layout, partial initialization behavior, stack cost and function return ownership
Scalar/type-to-type aliases beyond named STRUCTURE and ARRAY definitions and assignment/conversion rules across aliases

Controller observation of named ARRAY component ownership and aliases; inline anonymous nested ARRAY syntax remains blocked. Named ARRAY definitions and nested components are recorded in named_array_semantics.json and subarray_semantics.json
Nested/complex USING field scopes, namespace collisions and external/shared type consistency checks
Controller storage layout, alias observations, exceptions and alarm/task behavior

position_update.boundary: POSITION/XYZWPREXT can be fields. POSITION orientation descendants remain protected even through nested structure copies.

structure_routine_update.boundary: Prior exact named STRUCTURE results and independent writable value copies are supported with full recursive initialization/type/capacity guards. Whole ARRAY values and controller behavior remain blocked; restricted results use array_routine_semantics.json; exact positional copies are covered in positional_routine_semantics.json.
